## Question and source

Can alcohol and color intensity help describe differences among three anonymous
wine cultivars? The [UCI Wine dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/109/wine)
contains chemical measurements for 178 wines from one Italian region [@uci_wine].
This local CSV was exported from scikit-learn's `load_wine` [@sklearn_wine].
Each row is one wine sample; cultivar numbers are labels, not quality ratings.

## Load and summarize

The code runs from the folder containing `wine.csv`. If you copied the bundle
into `context/`, change the path to `context/wine.csv`. The summaries give each
wine equal weight. Sample standard deviation uses `n - 1` and describes spread
among wines in this dataset, not uncertainty in a population effect.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

wine = pd.read_csv("wine.csv")
assert len(wine) == 178 and wine["sample_id"].is_unique
assert set(wine["cultivar"]) == {1, 2, 3}
print(wine[["sample_id", "cultivar", "alcohol", "color_intensity"]].head().to_string(index=False))

summary = wine.groupby("cultivar").agg(
    samples=("sample_id", "count"),
    alcohol_mean=("alcohol", "mean"),
    alcohol_median=("alcohol", "median"),
    alcohol_sd=("alcohol", "std"),
    color_mean=("color_intensity", "mean"),
    color_median=("color_intensity", "median"),
    color_sd=("color_intensity", "std"),
)
print(summary.round(2).to_string())
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-wine-chemistry
#| fig-cap: "Alcohol and color intensity for all 178 UCI wine samples, grouped by anonymous cultivar."
#| fig-alt: "Scatterplot of 178 wines. Cultivar 2 tends toward lower alcohol and color intensity; the groups overlap. Exact group summaries appear above."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))
for cultivar, group in wine.groupby("cultivar"):
    ax.scatter(group["alcohol"], group["color_intensity"],
               label=f"Cultivar {cultivar}", alpha=0.76, s=32)
ax.set_xlabel("Alcohol (dataset measurement)")
ax.set_ylabel("Color intensity (dataset measurement)")
ax.legend(title="Anonymous label")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Interpretation and limits

The cultivar averages differ, but individual samples overlap. The chart uses
only two of 13 features; it is a description, not a fitted classifier. We have
no tasting scores, named grape varieties, or sampling design that would support
claims about flavor, quality, causality, or performance on new wines.
